awaken.jei.codex.essence_shard.title: Essence Shard
awaken.jei.codex.essence_shard.text: What awakened creatures leave behind. Hunters at night drop about one for every two kills, most other creatures drop some, and gate monsters, Lords, named beasts, anomalies and ruin caches drop more. Nearly every Awaken recipe takes a few. It charges Essence Cells, feeds the Reactor, pays the Forge and the Hearth Anchor's upgrades, and buys from gate markets.
awaken.jei.codex.lord_heart.title: Lord's Heart
awaken.jei.codex.lord_heart.text: The heart of a Gate Lord. Lords drop it; gate breaks and treasure hoards give it up, and a Lord's market stall sells one for 12 shards. It is the core of the Hearth Anchor, of higher Hunter gear (C and B chests and foci, most of A and S), of Precursor alloy, the Clone Vat and the Launch Ring.
awaken.jei.codex.power_core.title: Power Core
awaken.jei.codex.power_core.text: Holds one power. Use it to learn that power, or to level one you already know (up to level 5); at level 5, sneak-use swaps its variant. Gate Lords and elites drop cores, gate hoards and anomalies hold them, the Descent's guardians guard them, and four Core Shards fuse into one.
awaken.jei.codex.core_shard.title: Power Core Shard
awaken.jei.codex.core_shard.text: A splinter of a Power Core. The Hearth Anchor pays them for the requests you fill. Hold four and use them: they fuse into a whole core, its power drawn from those of your rank.
awaken.jei.codex.essence_cell.title: Essence Cell
awaken.jei.codex.essence_cell.text: Holds up to 1,000 essence. Use a shard on it for 100; sneak-use pours in all the shards that fit. Frames draw from the cells you carry, a Reactor drinks a cell dry, and sneak-using a Reactor fills one back up. Some ruins hold cells already charged.
awaken.jei.codex.precursor_scanner.title: Precursor Scanner
awaken.jei.codex.precursor_scanner.text: Point it at a broken machine in a Precursor ruin to read its blueprint into your Codex and the Fabricator; the first read also teaches the Essence Reactor. It reads log terminals too. Raise it at the sky and sweep: it beeps faster as you face the nearest ruin you haven't found.
awaken.jei.codex.fabricator.title: Fabricator
awaken.jei.codex.fabricator.text: Builds every Precursor machine whose blueprint you have scanned, from the parts in your pack. It needs no power. Its screen lists only the blueprints you know, so every broken machine you find adds one.
awaken.jei.codex.hearth_anchor.title: Hearth Anchor
awaken.jei.codex.hearth_anchor.text: Place it to make a home: you respawn here, Oren the Blacksmith arrives and a small Spire rises nearby. It reaches 48 blocks at first, 8 more each tier. Rooms are found by what's in them: a Sanctuary, an Armory, a Trophy Hall, a Workshop, a Barracks. It teaches the Hearth's furniture.
awaken.jei.codex.forge.title: Forge
awaken.jei.codex.forge.text: Temper any weapon or armour piece here: one level anywhere, two per Forge tier inside an Armory (an anvil, a Forge and an armour stand in one room). Use it empty-handed to upgrade the Forge itself. Tempered gear keeps its set bonus.
awaken.jei.codex.trophy.title: Trophy
awaken.jei.codex.trophy.kind: The Hearth · proof of a kill
awaken.jei.codex.trophy.text: A boss you kill always leaves its first trophy, then one time in five. Hang it on a Trophy Mount at home: every different boss on your walls adds 1% attack damage and 0.5 max health.
awaken.jei.codex.dream_journal.title: Dream Journal
awaken.jei.codex.dream_journal.text: You wake from your first dream holding one. Use it, or use a bed with it, to set tonight's intention: find the door, face the fear, or fly. Write the dream down within two minutes of waking to raise your Recall.
awaken.jei.codex.dream_residue.title: Dream Residue
awaken.jei.codex.dream_residue.text: What a dream leaves on your hands. Anything you kill in a dream drops it, and the door of intention, a beaten nightmare and a beaten mentor give more. It builds Dream Bells, Dream Glass, Dream Cloud and Shifting Stone, and Veilwoven and Sovereign gear.
awaken.jei.codex.gear_wildhide.title: Wildhide
awaken.jei.codex.gear_wildhide.text: Hide, essence and a few bones: the first set, makeable in your first hour from what the wild drops. Stone-sword blades, copper-grade armour, a mattock that mines like a stone pick.
awaken.jei.codex.gear_beastbound.title: Beastbound
awaken.jei.codex.gear_beastbound.text: Beast trophies and the E-rank Lords' parts make iron-grade gear without a single iron ore; its mattock already mines diamonds.
awaken.jei.codex.gear_gatewrought.title: Gatewrought
awaken.jei.codex.gear_gatewrought.text: Forged from the D-rank Gate Lords' parts: diamond-grade, and tuned to the Five Forces.
awaken.jei.codex.gear_veilwoven.title: Veilwoven
awaken.jei.codex.gear_veilwoven.text: Woven with echo shards and dream residue around the C- and B-rank Lords' parts: netherite-grade, and half in the Veil.
awaken.jei.codex.gear_lordscale.title: Lordscale
awaken.jei.codex.gear_lordscale.text: The B- and A-rank Lords' parts and a Lord's Heart: past netherite, and it changes your silhouette.
awaken.jei.codex.gear_sovereign.title: Sovereign Weave
awaken.jei.codex.gear_sovereign.text: The Herald's parts, the Architect's Key and, in time, the Hollow Court's own: the last set there is.
